economyRule.text: Rewards are consumable boosters, stars and leaderboard place. No soft and no hard currency in v1. Daily and level rewards give boosters; the shop sells booster packs for real money; the game spends boosters itself. Scrap soft currency is the next stage (deferredCurrencies) because the platform cannot yet publish exchange rules and start balance. Hard currency never goes into progress, level or onboarding rewards; the start grant is a separate reward.

cap.src: decision:economy-design: safety bound of the inventory entity (3-digit HUD counter). Unreachable in practice: a non-payer gets at most 48 bubbles per campaign + 260 per year of daily; the largest pack adds 35 per type. The client never blocks purchases or rewards by the cap; services-publish sets it on the inventory entity only if the platform supports caps
